questions.question: Choose the tense required by the finished time yesterday: I ___ a jacket yesterday.

explanation.en: A specified finished past time takes past simple.
explanation.ru: Указанное завершённое время в прошлом требует past simple.
explanation.kk: Көрсетілген аяқталған өткен уақыт past simple-ді қажет етеді.

questions.question: Complete: When ___ you buy those shoes?

explanation.en: When asking about a finished purchase, use did + base verb.
explanation.ru: Вопрос о завершённой покупке строится как did + базовая форма глагола.
explanation.kk: Аяқталған сатып алу туралы сұрақ did + етістіктің негізгі формасы арқылы құрылады.

questions.question: Complete: I ___ never bought anything from that website.

explanation.en: Have never + participle describes life experience up to now.
explanation.ru: Have never + причастие описывает жизненный опыт до настоящего момента.
explanation.kk: Have never + participle қазіргі сәтке дейінгі өмір тәжірибесін сипаттайды.

questions.question: Complete: She ___ this coat last Saturday.

explanation.en: Last Saturday is a finished past time.
explanation.ru: Last Saturday — это завершённое время в прошлом.
explanation.kk: Last Saturday — аяқталған өткен уақыт.

questions.question: Complete: Have you ever ___ a refund online?

explanation.en: Have you ever takes a past participle.
explanation.ru: После Have you ever стоит причастие прошедшего времени (past participle).
explanation.kk: Have you ever-ден кейін past participle тұрады.

questions.question: Choose the correct question about life experience.

options.text: Have you ever sell anything online?
Have you ever sold anything online?
Has you ever sold anything online?
Do you ever sold anything online?
Did you ever sold anything online?

explanation.en: Present perfect is formed with have + subject + participle.
explanation.ru: Present perfect образуется как have + подлежащее + причастие.
explanation.kk: Present perfect have + бастауыш + participle түрінде жасалады.

questions.question: Choose the correct question about a dated purchase.

options.text: Have you ordered the book on Monday?
Did you order the book on Monday?
Were you order the book on Monday?
Has you ordered the book on Monday?
Did you ordered the book on Monday?

explanation.en: The stated finished time calls for did + base verb.
explanation.ru: Названное завершённое время требует did + базовая форма глагола.
explanation.kk: Аталған аяқталған уақыт did + етістіктің негізгі формасын қажет етеді.

questions.question: Complete: I have visited that shop twice, but I ___ there yesterday.

explanation.en: Yesterday requires past simple, with didn't + go.
explanation.ru: Yesterday требует past simple: didn't + go.
explanation.kk: Yesterday past simple-ді қажет етеді: didn't + go.

questions.question: Complete: A: Have you ever been to London? B: Yes, I ___ there in 2022.

explanation.en: The specific year requires past simple.
explanation.ru: Конкретный год требует past simple.
explanation.kk: Нақты жыл past simple-ді қажет етеді.

questions.question: Complete: ___ you returned the damaged item yet?

explanation.en: Yet with a completed action up to now fits present perfect.
explanation.ru: Yet с действием, завершённым к настоящему моменту, подходит для present perfect.
explanation.kk: Қазіргі сәтке дейін аяқталған әрекетпен қолданылатын yet present perfect-ке сәйкес келеді.

questions.question: Complete the short answer: Did the parcel arrive on Friday? — Yes, it ___.

explanation.en: Match did in the question.
explanation.ru: Согласуйте форму с did в вопросе.
explanation.kk: Сұрақтағы did-ке сәйкестендіріңіз.

questions.question: Complete the short answer: Has the parcel arrived? — No, it ___.

explanation.en: Match has in the present perfect question.
explanation.ru: Согласуйте форму с has в вопросе present perfect.
explanation.kk: Present perfect сұрағындағы has-қа сәйкестендіріңіз.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly describes a finished purchase with a stated date?

options.text: I paying for the camera on 12 May.
I have paid for the camera on 12 May.
I did paid for the camera on 12 May.
I has paid for the camera on 12 May.
I paid for the camera on 12 May.

explanation.en: A stated finished date normally takes past simple.
explanation.ru: Указанная завершённая дата обычно требует past simple.
explanation.kk: Көрсетілген аяқталған күн әдетте past simple-ді қажет етеді.

questions.question: Which question asks for the exact time of a completed purchase?

explanation.en: When did asks about the time of a past event.
explanation.ru: When did спрашивает о времени события в прошлом.
explanation.kk: When did өткендегі оқиғаның уақытын сұрайды.

questions.question: What do you usually get to prove that you paid for something?

explanation.en: A receipt records payment for a purchase.
explanation.ru: Receipt (чек) фиксирует оплату покупки.
explanation.kk: Receipt (чек) сатып алу төлемін растайды.

questions.question: What is a refund?

explanation.en: A refund returns money to the buyer.
explanation.ru: Refund (возврат денег) возвращает деньги покупателю.
explanation.kk: Refund (ақшаны қайтару) ақшаны сатып алушыға қайтарады.

questions.question: Complete: These shoes are too small. Can I ___ them for a larger size?

explanation.en: Exchange means replace something with another item.
explanation.ru: Exchange означает заменить вещь на другую.
explanation.kk: Exchange бір затты басқасына ауыстыруды білдіреді.

questions.question: What does out of stock mean?

explanation.en: Out of stock means the seller has none available.
explanation.ru: Out of stock означает, что у продавца товара нет в наличии.
explanation.kk: Out of stock сатушыда тауар жоқ дегенді білдіреді.

questions.question: Complete: The website says delivery is free, so I won't pay for ___.

explanation.en: Shipping refers to sending goods to the customer.
explanation.ru: Shipping (доставка, отправка) — отправка товаров покупателю.
explanation.kk: Shipping — тауарларды тұтынушыға жөнелту.

questions.question: Choose the polite request in a clothes shop.

options.text: You are not allowed to answer.
Why don't you close the shop forever?
Could I try this on, please?

explanation.en: Try on means put clothes on to check fit and appearance.
explanation.ru: Try on означает надеть одежду, чтобы проверить размер и внешний вид.
explanation.kk: Try on өлшемі мен көрінісін тексеру үшін киімді киіп көруді білдіреді.

questions.question: Read: A jacket costs £40 online and delivery costs £5. What is the total price?

explanation.en: Add the product price and delivery charge.
explanation.ru: Сложите цену товара и стоимость доставки.
explanation.kk: Тауар бағасы мен жеткізу ақысын қосыңыз.

questions.question: Read: Mia ordered shoes on Tuesday. They arrived on Friday, but the size was wrong. Why does she want to return them?

explanation.en: The text says the size was wrong.
explanation.ru: В тексте сказано, что размер был неправильным.
explanation.kk: Мәтінде өлшем дұрыс болмағаны айтылған.

questions.question: Read: Shop A sells a bag for £30 with £8 delivery. Shop B sells the same bag for £35 with free delivery. Which is cheaper overall?

explanation.en: Shop A totals £38 and Shop B totals £35.
explanation.ru: Итого в магазине A £38, в магазине B £35.
explanation.kk: A дүкенінде барлығы £38, B дүкенінде £35.

questions.question: Complete the shop assistant’s question about a finished time. “___ the jacket here last Saturday?”

explanation.en: Last Saturday is a finished past time, so use did + subject + base verb.
explanation.ru: Last Saturday — завершённое время в прошлом, поэтому используйте did + подлежащее + базовая форма глагола.
explanation.kk: Last Saturday — аяқталған өткен уақыт, сондықтан did + бастауыш + етістіктің негізгі формасын қолданыңыз.

questions.question: Choose the question about experience at any time up to now.

options.text: Have you ever returned an online order?
When did you return that parcel?
Did you return the parcel yesterday?
Do you return your parcels on Mondays?

explanation.en: Have you ever asks about experience without specifying a finished time.
explanation.ru: Have you ever спрашивает об опыте без указания завершённого времени.
explanation.kk: Have you ever аяқталған уақытты көрсетпей, тәжірибе туралы сұрайды.

questions.question: In a shop, which question asks if the amount you must pay includes the delivery charge?

options.text: Have you got a smaller size?
Can I collect it from the shop?
Where can I try it on?

explanation.en: Include delivery asks whether the delivery cost is already part of the price.
explanation.ru: Include delivery спрашивает, входит ли стоимость доставки уже в цену.
explanation.kk: Include delivery жеткізу құны бағаға кіретін-кірмейтінін сұрайды.

questions.question: “Click and collect is free.” What can the customer do for free?

options.text: Ask for delivery to any address.
Order online and pick up the item at the collection point.
Change the price listed on the site.
Return any used product without a receipt.

explanation.en: Click and collect combines online ordering with collection in person.
explanation.ru: Click and collect сочетает заказ онлайн и самовывоз.
explanation.kk: Click and collect онлайн тапсырыс беруді және өзі барып алуды біріктіреді.

questions.question: A website lists a £24 bag with £4 standard delivery. Collection at the shop is free. What will a customer pay if they collect the bag?

explanation.en: The £4 delivery charge does not apply to free collection.
explanation.ru: Плата за доставку £4 не относится к бесплатному самовывозу.
explanation.kk: £4 жеткізу ақысы тегін өзі барып алуға қолданылмайды.

questions.question: Read the email. “Your order arrived at our shop on Tuesday. We have put it aside for you. Please collect it by Friday at 6 p.m.” What should the customer do?

options.text: Send the order back before Tuesday.
Collect the order only after Friday.
Pick the order up by Friday at 6 p.m.
Wait for the order at home on Friday.

explanation.en: By Friday at 6 p.m. is the latest collection time.
explanation.ru: By Friday at 6 p.m. — самый поздний срок получения заказа.
explanation.kk: By Friday at 6 p.m. — тапсырысты алудың ең соңғы уақыты.
